title: ophrys heldreichii subsp. pharia
intro: Ophrys heldreichii subsp. pharia, commonly known as the Heldreich's Bee Orchid, is a rare and unique orchid species found in Greece. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys heldreichii subsp. pharia include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic effects, which may help in reducing inflammation and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
